<observations>
Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User planning kitchen remodel (contractor quote $18,400) featuring a modern island, undermount stainless sink ($515 model), and matte black faucet with pull-out spray head.
* 🟡 (18:05) Fixture selections deadline set for May 10, 2026; GreenPipe Co. confirmed for plumbing.

Date: May 7, 2026
* 🔴 (15:20) User approved brushed nickel hardware, 2-cm quartz waterfall countertop ($4,200), and herringbone backsplash; revised contractor quote is $21,250.

Date: May 10, 2026
* 🔴 (15:15) User selected "Arctic Fog" paint, pot-filler faucet, pull-out pantry, ChillBox under-counter fridge, and herb kit, setting appliance deadline to May 18, 2026.

Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (14:10) User selected "Calacatta Gold" quartz island ($4,750), dimmable 3000K LED lighting, and VinoVault wine cooler; rule set: always send photos before opening walls.

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 (11:50) User selected matte white 'LunaSeries' cabinets and 'Arctic Pearl' glass tile backsplash; demolition rescheduled to May 27 due to user travel (May 24-26).
* ✅ (14:45) Revised 3-D kitchen model uploaded showing cabinets, backsplash, and coffee station.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (18:00) User selected "RiverEdge" quartz countertops ($3,200/slab, delivery June 8), Nimbus pendant lights, and EcoTemp Pro thermostat; appliance allowance is $6,300.
* ✅ (14:00) Revised floor plan and milestone schedule updated for June installations and inspections.
</observations>

<current-task>
Kitchen remodel planning and milestone tracking (next major dates: countertop delivery June 8, lighting installation June 13, thermostat setup June 15).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide further input or updates regarding the kitchen remodel selections.
</suggested-response>
